items.stem: Which is the safest response to an unexpected email asking you to urgently confirm your password via a link?

options.text: Do not click; verify through a known official channel and report it
options.rationale: Correct: urgency and credential requests are classic phishing signs.

options.text: Click the link and enter your password quickly
options.rationale: This is exactly what a phishing attack wants.

options.text: Forward it to all colleagues to warn them by example
options.rationale: Forwarding the live link spreads the risk.

options.text: Reply with your password to save time
options.rationale: Legitimate services never ask for your password by email.

items.explanation: Correct: avoid the link, verify independently, and report it.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO habits improve account security? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Using a unique strong password per account, ideally via a manager
options.rationale: Correct: unique passwords limit the damage of any one breach.
Correct: MFA stops a stolen password from being enough.
Reuse means one breach compromises many accounts.

options.text: Writing passwords on a sticky note on the monitor
options.rationale: Visible written passwords are easily stolen.

items.explanation: Correct: unique passwords and MFA both strengthen account security.

items.stem: You realise you clicked a suspicious link yesterday. What should you do?

options.text: Report it promptly so the team can check and contain any impact
options.rationale: Correct: prompt reporting enables quick containment.

options.text: Say nothing and hope nothing happened
options.rationale: Silence delays containment and increases risk.

options.text: Delete your browser history to hide it
options.rationale: Hiding it removes evidence and does not reduce risk.

options.text: Wait a month to see if anything breaks
options.rationale: Delay gives an attacker more time.

items.explanation: Correct: prompt reporting lets the team contain any impact.
